calculation.description: Fade the completed three-session return, with the reversal magnitude amplified when the prior completed session had unusually high volume relative to its trailing 20-session mean. All inputs are lagged so the signal is available without future data.

validation.regime_notes: Passes the benchmark daily absolute IC and ICIR gates, but the usable cross-section is sparse because volume is unavailable for many benchmark observations. Only 107 dates met the 8-name minimum; uncertainty is therefore high and the factor should be independently reviewed before production use.
